name: coding-agent-orchestrator
description: Explicit-only Coding Agent Orchestrator (CAO) for exact-thread deterministic .CAO state control while native Codex owns execution topology.
keywords: コーディング-エージェント-オーケストレーター

interface.shortDescription: Exact-thread state control for native Codex coding.
interface.longDescription: Coding Agent Orchestrator binds an explicit coding objective to deterministic .CAO state. Native Codex owns decomposition, subagent choice, model selection, recursive delegation, peer messaging, supervision, integration, and acceptance. Official Hooks provide immediate state rehydration and lifecycle events; official app-server readback reconciles ancestry and coordination. Runtime completion never becomes semantic completion without parent integration and typed state evidence.
defaultPrompt: CAO bind this coding task to exact .CAO state while native Codex chooses execution.
Use $coding-agent-orchestrator for Hook-triggered state control and app-server reconciliation.
Continue the active CAO workflow from its exact durable state.
